title: UpstreamIssueRecord
description: Schema for upstream dependency issue records in the study ledger. See docs/upstream_issues/README.md.

slug.description: Short kebab-case identifier. Must match the companion Markdown filename.

package.description: Affected package name and pinned version, e.g. 'transformers==4.44.2'.

severity.description: blocking: run cannot continue. degrading: results affected. cosmetic: no numerical effect.

issue_url.description: URL of the filed upstream issue, or null if not filed.

pr_url.description: URL of the filed upstream PR, or null if not filed.

workaround.description: Brief description of the applied workaround, or null if none yet.

workaround_commit.description: Study-repo commit SHA that applied the workaround.

resolved_upstream.description: true if fixed upstream, false if open, null if unknown.

resolved_version.description: First upstream release containing the fix, or null.

affected_gates.description: List of gate names whose results could be affected.

affected_runs.description: List of run IDs where the issue was observed.

status.description: Current status of the issue within this study.
